//! Handles stratification of Datalog programs

use petgraph::{algo, graphmap::DiGraphMap};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::slice::Iter;
use syn::Ident;

pub struct Strata {
    list: Vec<Vec<Ident>>,
    index: HashMap<Ident, usize>,
}

impl Strata {
    pub fn new(relations: HashSet<Ident>, dependencies: HashSet<(&Ident, &Ident)>) -> Self {
        // Build a directed graph of dependencies
        let mut graph: DiGraphMap<&Ident, ()> = DiGraphMap::new();

        // Add all relations as nodes
        for rel in &relations {
            graph.add_node(rel);
        }

        // Add edges for dependencies
        for (from, to) in &dependencies {
            graph.add_edge(from, to, ());
        }

        // Compute strongly connected components to handle cycles
        let sccs = algo::kosaraju_scc(&graph);

        // Map each relation to its SCC index
        let mut rel_to_scc: HashMap<&Ident, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for (scc_idx, scc) in sccs.iter().enumerate() {
            for rel in scc {
                rel_to_scc.insert(rel, scc_idx);
            }
        }

        // Build a graph of SCCs to compute stratification order
        let mut scc_graph: DiGraphMap<usize, ()> = DiGraphMap::new();
        for i in 0..sccs.len() {
            scc_graph.add_node(i);
        }

        // Add edges between SCCs based on original dependencies
        for (from, to) in &dependencies {
            let from_scc = rel_to_scc[from];
            let to_scc = rel_to_scc[to];
            if from_scc != to_scc {
                scc_graph.add_edge(from_scc, to_scc, ());
            }
        }

        // Compute topological ordering of SCCs using DFS
        let mut strata_order = Vec::new();
        let mut visited = vec![false; sccs.len()];
        let mut temp_mark = vec![false; sccs.len()];

        fn visit(
            node: usize,
            graph: &DiGraphMap<usize, ()>,
            visited: &mut Vec<bool>,
            temp_mark: &mut Vec<bool>,
            order: &mut Vec<usize>,
        ) {
            if visited[node] {
                return;
            }
            if temp_mark[node] {
                return;
            }

            temp_mark[node] = true;

            for neighbor in graph.neighbors(node) {
                visit(neighbor, graph, visited, temp_mark, order);
            }

            temp_mark[node] = false;
            visited[node] = true;
            order.push(node);
        }

        for i in 0..sccs.len() {
            if !visited[i] {
                visit(i, &scc_graph, &mut visited, &mut temp_mark, &mut strata_order);
            }
        }

        strata_order.reverse();

        // Map each SCC to its stratum index
        let mut scc_to_stratum: HashMap<usize, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for (stratum_idx, scc_idx) in strata_order.iter().enumerate() {
            scc_to_stratum.insert(*scc_idx, stratum_idx);
        }

        // Build the final strata list and index
        let mut list = vec![Vec::new(); sccs.len()];
        let mut index = HashMap::new();

        for rel in relations {
            let scc_idx = rel_to_scc[&rel];
            let stratum_idx = scc_to_stratum[&scc_idx];
            list[stratum_idx].push(rel.clone());
            index.insert(rel, stratum_idx);
        }

        // Remove empty strata
        list.retain(|stratum| !stratum.is_empty());

        // Update indices after removing empty strata
        let mut final_index = HashMap::new();
        for (rel, stratum_idx) in index {
            let new_idx = list.iter().position(|s| s.contains(&rel)).unwrap();
            final_index.insert(rel, new_idx);
        }

        Strata {
            list,
            index: final_index,
        }
    }

    pub fn iter(&self) -> Iter<'_, Vec<Ident>> {
        self.list.iter()
    }

    pub fn find_relation(&self, rel: &Ident) -> usize {
        *self.index.get(rel).expect("key not found in stratum index")
    }
}
